title: Housing choice voucher program.
bodyText: No county shall disqualify a legal nonconforming dwelling unit from the housing choice voucher program if the unit meets zoning and building code requirements and other program standards such as health and safety standards.
bodyHtml: [§46-15.21]  Housing choice voucher program.  No county shall disqualify a legal nonconforming dwelling unit from the housing choice voucher program if the unit meets zoning and building code requirements and other program standards such as health and safety standards. [L 2017, c 176, §1]
